name: Lake Tschida - Koehlers Point Campground (Grant County)
note: Primitive Lake Tschida sites in a row along the south shore at the tip of Koehlers Point, with a restroom, parking and a boat ramp; the road in crosses a private subdivision on a perpetual public easement. Sites are grass spots with a table and no pads. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: laketschida.org/koehlers-point (BOR/JJDA map: sites 1-10, restroom, parking, boat access; 'PUBLIC/PRIVATE ACCESS ROAD WITH PERPETUAL EASEMENT FOR PUBLIC TRAVEL') + koehlers-primitive booking page and Peek program JK1M selling single nights; photos show open grass sites a rig can pull onto -> real drive-in campground. Separate from Sled Creek (~1.25 km, other side of the arm) and 6025 (~7.5 km). Operator Lake Tschida Recreation (Tri-Cities Joint Job Development Authority, the managing partner with the Bureau of Reclamation; same operator and ownership as 6025 Rimrock), laketschida.org read 2026-11-12. 'Camping unit' covers motor homes and pull-type campers (campground rules). Horse rule passes: the Hidden Shelter page says it is 'the only campground at Lake Tschida that will accommodate horses' and it is a separate area. Long-stay test 4: every site is sold by the night on Peek; the private cabin and trailer permittee areas are separate lease areas, not campground sites. Public (local): no price gate or presence rule.
waterfront_evidence: 2026-11-12: the official map draws sites 1-10 along the inland edge of a mapped tree strip on the south shore; the operator's Peek photos show the lake through scattered trees beyond each table; Esri World Imagery (400 m frame at 46.6118,-101.9095) shows a tree belt 15-40 m deep along that shore with the sites ~25-35 m from the water behind it -> a treeline buffer, so lakeview, not lakefront (downgraded under the unsure rule). Dam ~7.7 km E.
fees_source: https://laketschida.org/camping-fees ('$14 nightly fee for a primitive campsite at all campsites'; '$24 nightly fee for electrical campsites.'), read 2026-11-12

sites.note: Primitive 1-10 on grass, no pads or posted size.

sites_source: https://laketschida.org/koehlers-primitive (KOEHLERS PRIMITIVE CAMPSITE 1-10), the Koehlers Point map and Peek photos, read 2026-11-12

booking.note: Online booking closes 7 days out; inside a week, book by phone with the office. Friday or Saturday arrivals must take two nights between Memorial Day and Labor Day weekends. Unreserved sites are first come, first served with envelopes at the self-registration kiosks (cash or check).

If you want to make a reservation less than 7 days in advance you must call the office'; 'the minimum of 2 NIGHTS is required between Memorial Day weekend and Labor Day weekend'; 'No campsite may be occupied for more than 14 consecutive days out of 30 consecutive days'); https://laketschida.org/camping-fees ('camping envelopes are provided at self-registration Kiosks ... First Come First Serve'); https://laketschida.org/general-information ('all unreserved sites are available on a first come first serve basis'); the area's Peek booking program; read 2026-11-12
flags: Waterfront downgraded to lakeview: the photos read close to lakefront (grass to a treed bank), but the imagery shows a tree belt between every site and the water.
Access crosses the private Red Rock Resort subdivision on an easement road (map).
Grass sites with no posted size; kept under the unclear-pad rule.
No season is published for any Lake Tschida area.
